worked: **Gotchas (reusable):** crab `/logs` severity floor param is `level`, not `min_severity` (internal name); crab has no top-level `team_id` (fold into payload both directions); FE `Severity` enum exactly matches crab's `trace..fatal` so `fatal` is not downgraded; the index-manipulation hook blocks ANY compound bash containing the substring `git stash` (even read-only `git stash list`) — run status/list separately; backend `.env` `LOG_LEVEL` filters INFO, so a sink smoke test must force `_configure(level="DEBUG")`.

**Architecture note for future agent:** the BE crab sink ships via the ONE loguru-singleton wiring point, so every existing `logger.error/.warning` across ~65 files now reaches crab with zero per-module work. ADR-008 (`frontend/docs/tech/decisions/ADR-008-backend-logging-consolidation.md`) is authoritative but we deliberately did REDUCED scope for the preview proof (skipped L2 per-request/per-task ctx binding and L4 level discipline).

**User feedback/preferences:** proof on crab's dashboard (not the admin tab); backend as `service=versable-backend`; UI logging structural-only (no PII); wants evidence not assertion; never commits in this repo.
